message.content: {"caption":"Two-panel line chart comparing PPO and GRPO training rewards for two language models.","description":"Two side-by-side line charts show training reward over horizontal-axis values from 0 to 200. The left panel, “(a) Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct,” and the right panel, “(b) Qwen-2.5-7B-Instruct,” each plot PPO as a red line and GRPO as a blue line, as identified by the legends. The vertical axis is Training Reward; the left panel shows ticks at 0.0, 0.1, 0.2, and 0.3, with the plotted scale extending to about 0.4. Both series are noisy. In the Llama panel, GRPO rises more quickly at first and is generally ahead early on, while PPO catches up and ends slightly higher; both finish at broadly similar rewards. In the Qwen panel, GRPO also rises earlier, and the lines then remain close, ending at similar levels with GRPO slightly higher. The horizontal axis has numeric ticks but no visible axis title. Values in chart_values are estimated read-offs at the labeled horizontal-axis ticks; no point values are
